figures.alt: Two three-by-three grids of single-cell fluorescence crops on black. Left grid labelled SAG1, right grid labelled GRA14. Each crop shows a HeLa cell with a blue nucleus, green GFP-TSG101 cytoplasm and red Toxoplasma vacuoles; in most SAG1 crops the vacuoles look yellow where green overlaps red, in the GRA14 crops they stay red.
figures.caption: The 9 held-out cells per class that spaCR's CNN classified correctly with the highest confidence, from 405 test cells in 4 wells never used for training (B02, C01, E02, G01); test accuracy 0.901.
figures.provenance: spaCR GFP-TSG101 recruitment screen, plate 1 (HF datasets einarolafsson/spacr-example-screen and einarolafsson/spacr-example-hit, CC BY 4.0; Olafsson EB et al.); 224 px single-cell PNG crops of those cells read from plate1-data.tar of spacr-example-screen (blue nuclei, green GFP-TSG101, red Toxoplasma); classes are the screen's control wells: column 1 (wells A01-H01, enriched for guides against SAG1, TGGT1_233460, the negative control) versus column 2 (A02-H02, enriched for guides against GRA14, TGGT1_239740, the positive control whose loss removes TSG101 recruitment to the vacuole). Classifier: MobileNetV3-small trained by spacr.deep_spacr.train_test_model; tiles drawn by spacr.plot.plot_image_grid (1-99.5 percentile stretch per channel).

figures.alt: Two-by-two confusion matrix heatmap in blues, true class on rows (SAG1 c1, GRA14 c2), predicted class on columns, with row-normalised fractions 0.81, 0.19, 0.12 and 0.88.
figures.caption: XGBoost on 76 GFP-TSG101-channel measurements per cell, 5-fold cross-validation with whole wells held out: 1,277 control cells from 16 wells, accuracy 0.853 (445 of 547 SAG1-well and 644 of 730 GRA14-well cells correct).
figures.provenance: spaCR GFP-TSG101 recruitment screen, plate 1 (HF datasets einarolafsson/spacr-example-screen and einarolafsson/spacr-example-hit, CC BY 4.0; Olafsson EB et al.); per-cell measurements from measurements.db of spacr-example-hit (the plate-1 cut of spacr-example-screen, fields 1-4); classes are the screen's control wells: column 1 (wells A01-H01, enriched for guides against SAG1, TGGT1_233460, the negative control) versus column 2 (A02-H02, enriched for guides against GRA14, TGGT1_239740, the positive control whose loss removes TSG101 recruitment to the vacuole). Model and features from spacr.ml.generate_ml_scores; folds from spacr.io.make_cv_folds grouped by well; figure by spacr.classifier_evaluation._write_confusion_figure (title removed).

figures.alt: Two panels. Left: ROC curve rising steeply toward the top-left corner above a dashed diagonal chance line, legend AUC = 0.922. Right: precision-recall curve mostly between 0.85 and 0.97 precision, falling at the highest recall, above a dashed prevalence line at 0.57, legend AP = 0.913.
figures.caption: ROC (AUC 0.922) and precision-recall (average precision 0.913) of the same well-held-out XGBoost predictions for 1,277 cells, GRA14 wells as the positive class (prevalence 0.57).
figures.provenance: spaCR GFP-TSG101 recruitment screen, plate 1 (HF datasets einarolafsson/spacr-example-screen and einarolafsson/spacr-example-hit, CC BY 4.0; Olafsson EB et al.); per-cell measurements from measurements.db of spacr-example-hit (the plate-1 cut of spacr-example-screen, fields 1-4); classes are the screen's control wells: column 1 (wells A01-H01, enriched for guides against SAG1, TGGT1_233460, the negative control) versus column 2 (A02-H02, enriched for guides against GRA14, TGGT1_239740, the positive control whose loss removes TSG101 recruitment to the vacuole). figures.alt: Two-by-two confusion matrix heatmap in blues for the image classifier, true class on rows, predicted on columns, fractions 0.92, 0.08, 0.12 and 0.88.
figures.caption: spaCR's CNN on single-cell crops of 405 held-out cells from 4 test wells: accuracy 0.901 (184 of 200 SAG1-well and 181 of 205 GRA14-well cells correct).

figures.caption: ROC (AUC 0.968) and precision-recall (average precision 0.970) of the CNN on 405 cells from 4 held-out wells, GRA14 wells as the positive class.

figures.alt: SHAP beeswarm: twelve feature names on the left, one row of coloured dots per feature along a horizontal SHAP value axis from about -1.1 to 1.4. The top rows, cell_channel_1_shannon_entropy and cell_channel_1_channel_2_M2_correlation_85, spread widest in both directions; lower rows cluster near zero.
figures.caption: SHAP values of the XGBoost model for 256 held-out cells from 3 wells (C02, D02, H01), top 12 of 76 features by mean |SHAP|; each dot is a cell coloured by its feature value (dark low, yellow high), and positive values push toward the GRA14 class.
figures.provenance: spaCR GFP-TSG101 recruitment screen, plate 1 (HF datasets einarolafsson/spacr-example-screen and einarolafsson/spacr-example-hit, CC BY 4.0; Olafsson EB et al.); per-cell measurements from measurements.db of spacr-example-hit (the plate-1 cut of spacr-example-screen, fields 1-4); classes are the screen's control wells: column 1 (wells A01-H01, enriched for guides against SAG1, TGGT1_233460, the negative control) versus column 2 (A02-H02, enriched for guides against GRA14, TGGT1_239740, the positive control whose loss removes TSG101 recruitment to the vacuole). SHAP values from spacr.ml._shap_values (TreeExplainer, tree_path_dependent) on the generate_ml_scores model; beeswarm drawn by spaCR's pyqtgraph FastPlot.add_beeswarm, as on the app's explanation panel.

figures.alt: SHAP waterfall for one cell: ten horizontal arrows, red pushing right and blue pushing left, from the expected value 0.178 at the bottom to f(x) = 1.545 at the top; cell_channel_1_shannon_entropy adds +0.92 and cell_channel_1_channel_2_M2_correlation_85 adds +0.47.
figures.caption: Per-cell SHAP explanation of one held-out GRA14-well cell (plate 1, well C02, field 1, object 35): the model's base value of 0.178 log-odds plus the feature contributions gives 1.545, a GRA14 probability of 0.82.
figures.provenance: spaCR GFP-TSG101 recruitment screen, plate 1 (HF datasets einarolafsson/spacr-example-screen and einarolafsson/spacr-example-hit, CC BY 4.0; Olafsson EB et al.); per-cell measurements from measurements.db of spacr-example-hit (the plate-1 cut of spacr-example-screen, fields 1-4); classes are the screen's control wells: column 1 (wells A01-H01, enriched for guides against SAG1, TGGT1_233460, the negative control) versus column 2 (A02-H02, enriched for guides against GRA14, TGGT1_239740, the positive control whose loss removes TSG101 recruitment to the vacuole). SHAP values from spacr.ml._shap_values; waterfall drawn by shap.plots.waterfall (spaCR has no per-cell SHAP plot) and saved with spacr.plot.save_figure.

figures.alt: Horizontal grey bar chart of the 15 most important measurement features, longest bar at the top for cell_channel_1_channel_2_M2_correlation_85 (about 0.20), then cell_channel_1_shannon_entropy (about 0.13), with the remaining bars below 0.06.
figures.caption: Top 15 of 76 features by XGBoost importance for the model trained on 1,021 control cells from 13 wells; cell_channel_1_channel_2_M2_correlation_85 ranks first (0.196), then cell_channel_1_shannon_entropy (0.133).
figures.provenance: spaCR GFP-TSG101 recruitment screen, plate 1 (HF datasets einarolafsson/spacr-example-screen and einarolafsson/spacr-example-hit, CC BY 4.0; Olafsson EB et al.); per-cell measurements from measurements.db of spacr-example-hit (the plate-1 cut of spacr-example-screen, fields 1-4); classes are the screen's control wells: column 1 (wells A01-H01, enriched for guides against SAG1, TGGT1_233460, the negative control) versus column 2 (A02-H02, enriched for guides against GRA14, TGGT1_239740, the positive control whose loss removes TSG101 recruitment to the vacuole). Importances are the fitted XGBClassifier's feature_importances_ written by spacr.ml.generate_ml_scores; bars drawn by spacr.plot.plot_feature_importance.

figures.alt: Four rows of five single-cell crops: SAG1 crops, their Grad-CAM heatmaps, GRA14 crops, their Grad-CAM heatmaps. Heatmaps are jet-coloured over a grey version of the crop; on GRA14 cells the hot spot sits on the red parasite vacuoles, on SAG1 cells heat also falls on the black background corners.
figures.caption: Grad-CAM maps of the CNN for the 5 most confident correct held-out cells per class; on GRA14-well cells 4-13% of the map falls on the masked black background, on SAG1-well cells 18-53%.
